distanthorizons.title: Distant Horizons
distanthorizons.general.disabledByApi.@t:
Ko tēnei tawhā e whakahaere ana tētahi atu mod mā te API o DH,
nō reira kāore e taea te huringa mai i te UI, i te kōnae config rānei.
Ko te mea e whakahaere ana ināianei:
distanthorizons.general.unsupportedMcVer:
Kāore a DH e tautoko i te huringa o tēnei tawhā i tēnei putanga Minecraft.
Ka warewarehia ngā uara katoa i tautuhia mai i te kōnae config, mai i te API rānei.

distanthorizons.config.client.quickEnabl: Ki te kua whakahohe, ka tāia e Distant Horizons ngā LOD i waho o te tawhiti tā vanilla.
distanthorizons.config.client.quickShowW: Whakaatu i te āhua whakatipu/kawemai LOD
Ki te kua whakahohe, ka whakaaturia te āhua whakatipu/kawemai ao i te mata i a koe e tākaro ana.
distanthorizons.config.client.qualityPre:
Ka whakarerekē a Distant Horizons i ētahi tautuhinga whakairoiro hei huringa tere i te kounga tā.

Mehemea kei te whakamahi katoa tō GPU, i te raruraru whakatere-whakapapa rānei, whakaiti i tēnei tautuhinga.
distanthorizons.config.client.threadPres:
Ka whakarerekē i te maha o ngā aho e whakamahia ana e Distant Horizons.

Ko te whakarahi i tēnei tautuhinga ka nui ake te tere o te whakatipu-tawhiti me te tere uta LOD,
engari ka nui hoki te whakamahi CPU/mahara, tērā pea ka tū te kēmu i te mutunga.

Ka whakatūpato: he tautuhinga pānga-CPU tēnei.
Me pēnei te pānga ki te CPU 64-kaute-arero pērā ki te CPU 2-kaute-arero.
distanthorizons.config.client.optionsBut: Whakaatu i te pātuhi config ki te taha mauī o te pātuhi fov
distanthorizons.config.client.advanced.g: Whakairoiro
Kounga
Pūtoro tawhiti tā poraka LOD

Ko te tawhiti tā o Distant Horizons, ka inea ki ngā poraka.

Ka whakatūpato: he tau tino pai tēnei.
Tērā pea ka rerekē te tawhiti tā tūturu i tēnei tau,
i runga i ōu atu tautuhinga whakairoiro.
Tawhiti whakaheke LOD

Ka whakaatu i te tawhiti o ngā whakahekenga kounga LOD.

Ko ngā tautuhinga nui ake ka nui ake te tawhiti i waenga i ngā whakahekenga,
engari ka nui ake te whakamahi mahara me te GPU.
Te taipitopito whakapae mōrahi

Ko te taipitopito mōrahi e taea ana te tā i ngā LOD.

§6Tere.§r Poraka
§6Tino taipitopito.§r Pūngao
Kounga pūhou

Te pai o te tā a ngā LOD i ngā pari, ngā ana, ngā tapa mamao, aha atu.

Ko ngā tawhā tiketike ka nui ake te whakamahi mahara me te GPU.
Whakamahi i te tūnga kamera mō ngā whakahekenga kounga

Ki te kua whakahohe, ka whakamahi a DH i te tūnga kamera
ina whakatau ana i ngā whakahekenga kounga LOD.
Ki te kua kāti, ka whakamahi a DH i te tūnga kaitākaro.

Ko te whakahohe ka āwhina i te tā tika o ngā āhua kamera-kore-wahanga.
Ko te kāti ka āwhina i te tā tika o ngā āhua kamera-maha (pērā i Immersive Portals, ngā mod kamera rānei).
Whakarahi i te kounga ina hōmārama

Ki te kua whakahohe, ka nui ake te kounga LOD ina hōmārama,
hei tauira i te wā e whakamahi ana i te telescope, i te mod wērea rānei.

Ka pā anake ki ngā LOD i roto i te ārai tirohanga o te kamera.

Ina hōmārama, ka uta ngā LOD ki te taumata taipitopito e whiwhi ai rātou ina tata mai.
Te whakarahinga kounga hōmārama mōrahi

E hia ngā taumata taipitopito e taea ai e te hōmārama te whakarahi i te kounga LOD.
Me ngā tau nui ake, ka tā motuhake ngā hōmārama kaha i te āhua whenua,
engari ka nui ake te whakamahi mahara me te GPU ina hōmārama.

Ka hiahia te telescope vanilla i 4 taumata taipitopito kia eke ki te kounga katoa.
Pātata whakapae

Te tere o te whakahekenga kounga o ngā LOD.

Ko ngā tau nui ake ka pai ake te āhua o te whenua tawhiti,
engari ka nui ake te whakamahi mahara me te GPU.
Mārama
Pāparakauranga LOD

Ka whakatau i te whakahaerenga o te pāparakauranga o ngā LOD.
Ka taea te whakamahi hei whakapai ake i te hototahi shader.
Tā-taha pātītī
Me pēhea te tā o ngā taha me te raro o ngā LOD poraka pātītī?
Enable LOD Block Models

If true nearby LODs will render blocks with their real shape 
instead of full cubes. 
If false all LODs render as full cubes. 

Only applies to the highest detail LODs.
Kāti i ngā LOD tata

Ki te kua whakahohe, ka kātia ngā LOD ina tata mai.
Ki te kua kāti, ka kotia ohorere ngā LOD i te tawhiti kua tautuhia mai i te kamera.
Ka pāngia pea tēnei tautuhinga e te config ārai tā-hirau vanilla.
Tikanga kāti vanilla

Me pēhea te kāti o te vanilla Minecraft i ngā LOD Distant Horizons?

NONE: tere, he rohenga mārama i waenga i te tā DH me te tā MC.
SINGLE_PASS: ka kātia i muri o te whakawhiti mārama o MC, kāore e kātia ngā poraka pakeke o raro-wai.
DOUBLE_PASS: pōturi rawa, ka kātia i muri o ngā whakawhiti pakeke, mārama hoki o MC, ka whakarata te whakawhiti.
Kāti i mua i te manuao tapatapahi tawhiti

Me kāti a DH i mua i te eke ki te manuao tapatapahi tawhiti?
Ka āwhina tēnei hei ārai i ngā kapua DH tawhiti kia kaua e kotia.
Whakarea mārama

Te kaha o te pāparakauranga o ngā tae LOD.

0 = Pango
1 = Nōmela
2 = Tātai-whiti
Whakarea pāparakaura

Te kaha o ngā tae LOD.

0 = Pango me te mā
1 = Nōmela
2 = Tino ora
Whakaranu-kōiora

He ōrite ki ngā tautuhinga Biome Blending vanilla mō tēnei horahanga LOD.

Ka whakatūpato: ka pōturi te uta o ngā LOD ki ngā uara nui ake i te '0'.

'0' = Biome Blending vanilla mō te '1x1',
'1' = Biome Blending vanilla mō te '3x3',
'2' = Biome Blending vanilla mō te '5x5'...
Whakahohe i te Ambient Occlusion
Ka hōmirohia e te Ambient Occlusion te mārama o ngā poraka.
Whakahohe i te Anti-Aliasing
Ka whakaene i ngā tapa o te Anti-Aliasing, ka iti ake te whakaata i te nekehanga.
Te tā noa o ngā mea
Whakahohe i te tā noa

Ki te kua whakahohe, ka tāia e DH ngā mea kāore i te rohe,
pērā i ngā rama tohu me ngā kapua.
Whakahohe i te tā tohu
Teitei tā tohu
Ka whakarite i te teitei mōrahi e tāia ai ngā tohu. Me uta anō te ao kia whai mana.
Whakaroa i ngā tohu tawhiti

Ki te kua whakahohe, ka tāia ngā rama tohu LOD kua whakaroatia i ngā tawhiti tino rahi,
ka māmā ake te kite.
Ki te kua kāti, ka 1 poraka te whānui o ngā rama tohu LOD katoa.
Ki te kua whakahohe, ka tāia ngā rama tohu LOD.
Whakahohe i te tā kapua
Ki te kua whakahohe, ka tāia ngā kapua LOD.
Rārangi CSV o ngā ārai kapua

He rārangi kaporowhā-mahue o ngā rohi rauemi o ngā ārai
e tāia ai ngā kapua e DH.

Hei tauira: "minecraft:overworld,minecraft:the_end"

Me uta anō te ao kia whai mana ngā huringa.
Whakahohe i ngā kapua hōhonu

Kua kāti = ka tāia e DH he kapua whānuitanga kotahi, pērā ki te vanilla Minecraft.
Kua whakahohe = ka tāia e DH e 3 ngā whānuitanga kapua ki ngā teitei rerekē.
Kōhū
Whakahohe i te kōhū Distant Horizons
Ka whakatau mēnā ka tāia te kōhū ki ngā tohu LOD.
Tikanga tae kōhū
Te tae o te kōhū i runga i ngā LOD.
Whakahohe i te kōhū vanilla

§6Whakahohe.§r ka tāia e Minecraft te kōhū pēnei i te nōmela.
§6Kāti.§r ka kāti te kōhū Minecraft i ngā poraka vanilla.

Tērā pea ka raruraru ētahi atu mod e tā ana i te kōhū.
Ngā tautuhinga kōhū ake
Tīmatanga kōhū

Me tīmata te kōhū i hea?

  '0.0': ka tīmata te kōhū i te tūnga o te kaitākaro.
  '1.0': ka ōrite te porowhita tīmata-kōhū ki te horahanga tawhiti tā LOD.
'1.414': ka noho te horahanga tawhiti tā LOD ki roto tonu i te porowhita tīmata-kōhū.
Whakamutunga kōhū

Me mutu te kōhū ki hea?

  '0.0': ka mutu te kōhū i te tūnga o te kaitākaro.
  '1.0': ka ōrite te porowhita whakamutunga-kōhū ki te horahanga tawhiti tā LOD.
'1.414': ka noho te horahanga tawhiti tā LOD ki roto tonu i te porowhita whakamutunga-kōhū.
Te kōhū mōrahi-iti

Kia pēhea te ngau kōhū mōrahi-iti?

  '0.0': Kāore he kōhū.
  '1.0': Te tae kōhū katoa.
Te kōhū mōrahi-nui

Kia pēhea te ngau kōhū mōrahi-nui?

  '0.0': Kāore he kōhū.
  '1.0': Te tae kōhū katoa.
Rōnakitanga kōhū

Me pēhea te tātai i te ngau o te kōhū?

LINEAR: hāngai i runga i te tawhiti (kāore e aro ki te ngau)
EXPONENTIAL: 1/(e^(distance*density))
EXPONENTIAL_SQUARED: 1/(e^((distance*density)^2))
Ngau kōhū
Kia pēhea te ngau o te kōhū?
Ngā tautuhinga kōhū teitei
Tikanga whakaranu kōhū teitei

Ka whakatau i te pānga o te teitei ki te kōhū.
Ki te kāore koe e mōhio, tīmata ki SPHERICAL, ADDITION, MAX rānei.

SPHERICAL: ka tātaihia te kōhū i runga i te tawhiti kamera.
CYLINDRICAL: kāore e aro ki te teitei, ka tātaihia te kōhū i runga i te tawhiti whakapae.
MAX: max(heightFog, farFog)
ADDITION: heightFog + farFog
MULTIPLY: heightFog * farFog
INVERSE_MULTIPLY: 1 - (1-heightFog) * (1-farFog)
LIMITED_ADDITION: farFog + max(farFog, heightFog)
MULTIPLY_ADDITION: farFog + farFog * heightFog
INVERSE_MULTIPLY_ADDITION: farFog + 1 - (1-heightFog) * (1-farFog)
AVERAGE: farFog*0.5 + heightFog*0.5
Rānei kōhū teitei

Me noho te kōhū teitei ki hea?

ABOVE_CAMERA: ka tīmata te kōhū teitei ki runga ake o te kamera
BELOW_CAMERA: ka tīmata te kōhū teitei ki raro iho o te kamera
ABOVE_AND_BELOW_CAMERA: ka tīmata te kōhū teitei ki runga ake, ki raro iho hoki o te kamera
ABOVE_SET_HEIGHT: ka tīmata te kōhū teitei ki runga ake o te teitei kua tāu
BELOW_SET_HEIGHT: ka tīmata te kōhū teitei ki raro iho o te teitei kua tāu
ABOVE_AND_BELOW_SET_HEIGHT: ka tīmata te kōhū teitei ki runga ake, ki raro iho hoki o te teitei kua tāu
Teitei matua o te kōhū teitei
Ina tātaihia te kōhū teitei ki te taha o te teitei kua tāu, kei hea taua teitei?
Tīmatanga kōhū teitei

Kia pēhea te whakanekatanga o te tīmatanga kōhū teitei?

  '0.0': ka tīmata te kōhū kāore he nekehanga.
  '1.0': ka tīmata te kōhū kua nekehia ki te teitei katoa o te ao. (hōhonu ake)
Whakamutunga kōhū teitei

Kia pēhea te whakanekatanga o te whakamutunga kōhū teitei?

  '0.0': ka mutu te kōhū kāore he nekehanga.
  '1.0': ka mutu te kōhū kua nekehia ki te teitei katoa o te ao. (hōhonu ake)
Te kōhū teitei mōrahi-iti

Kia pēhea te ngau kōhū mōrahi-iti?

  '0.0': Kāore he kōhū.
  '1.0': Te tae kōhū katoa.
Te kōhū teitei mōrahi-nui

Kia pēhea te ngau kōhū mōrahi-nui?

  '0.0': Kāore he kōhū.
  '1.0': Te tae kōhū katoa.
Rōnakitanga kōhū teitei

Me pēhea te tātai i te ngau o te kōhū teitei?

LINEAR: hāngai i runga i te teitei (kāore e aro ki te ngau)
EXPONENTIAL: 1/(e^(height*density))
EXPONENTIAL_SQUARED: 1/(e^((height*density)^2))
Ngau kōhū teitei
Kia pēhea te ngau o te kōhū teitei?
Ngā kakano LOD
Whakahohe i ngā kakano LOD

Ki te kua whakahohe, ka tāia ngā LOD tata, hōmārama-tō rānei ki te kakano me te āhua
o ō rātou poraka ake, kaua ki te tae kī.

Ka whakamahia noa ngā kakano ki ngā LOD e tino taipitopito ana kia kitea e te pai te kakano,
ka whakamahi tonu ngā LOD tawhiti i te tae kī.
Kāore he pānga ina kua whakahohe te pēke shader, nā te mea ka tāia ngā LOD
e ngā pēke shader ki ō rātou ake papatono.
Taumata taipitopito kakano mōrahi

Ko te taumata taipitopito mōrahi ka tāia me te kakano poraka.
Ki ngā taumata taipitopito tiketike, ka hērā ngā poraka maha ki ia LOD,
ka iti ake ngā kakano i te pika kotahi, kāore rā hoki ka kitea.

Ka hoatu e ngā tau nui te kakano ki ngā LOD tawhiti, engari ka nui ake te whakamahinga mahara.
Ngā poraka kāore i te taatara

He rārangi kaporowhā-mahue o ngā rohi rauemi poraka
kāore e tāia ai e DH ngā kakano.
Ka ōrite hoki ngā ōritenga wāhanga/ngā rohi rauemi kāore i te tino rahi.

 Hei tauira: "minecraft:grass_block,nylium"

 Me tīmata anō mō ngā huringa.
Ngā poraka kāore i te whakamahi i te kakano taha

He rārangi kaporowhā-mahue o ngā rohi rauemi poraka
e tāia ai e DH ngā taha me te kakano o raro.
Ka ōrite hoki ngā ōritenga wāhanga/ngā rohi rauemi kāore i te tino rahi.

Hei tauira: "minecraft:grass_block,nylium"

Me tīmata anō mō ngā huringa.
Ngā tāg poraka kāore i te whakamahi i te kakano taha

He rārangi kaporowhā-mahue o ngā ingoa tāg
e tāia ai e DH ngā taha me te kakano o raro.

Hei tauira: "grass_blocks,nylium"

Me tīmata anō mō ngā huringa.
Ngā kakano poraka rastering-onamata

He rārangi kaporowhā-mahue o ngā rohi rauemi poraka
e whakamahi ana a DH i te raster ki te whakatau i te kakano mata.

Ka taea te whakamahi ki te whakatika i ngā raruraru o ngā mod/poraka
e whakamahi ana te taha i tētahi wāhanga anake o te kakano tauira poraka.

Hei tauira: "minecraft:beacon"

Me tīmata anō mō ngā huringa.
Ngā kakano haruru
Whakahohe i ngā kakano haruru
Ki te kua whakahohe, ka whakamahia ngā kakano haruru ki ngā LOD hei whakaaro ki ngā kakano.
Ngā taumata haruru
Ka whakatau i te maha o ngā taumata haruru e whakamahia ana ki ngā LOD.
Te kaha o te haruru
Ka whakatau i te kaha o ngā kakano haruru.
Rōnakitanga haruru

Ka whakatau i te tawhiti e tāia ai ngā kakano haruru i mua i te kāti. (i roto i ngā poraka)
Kāti i te haruru mā te tautuhi ki te 0.
Te kotinga
Te ārai i te tā hirau

Ka whakatau i te tawhiti i mua i te tīmatanga o te tā a DH.
He ōrau o te tawhiti tā vanilla.
-1 = aunoa, ka rerekē te ārai i te tā hirau i runga i te tawhiti tā vanilla.

Ka ārai ngā uara nui i ngā LOD kia kāore e tāia ki muri i ngā poraka vanilla i tawhiti,
engari ka kitea pea ngā rua i ngā LOD.
Tērā pea ka kitea ngā rua ina rere i ngā wāhi kāore i utaina.

Ka nui ake te hua o tēnei tautuhinga me te whakarahi i te tawhiti tā vanilla.
Whakaiti i te ārai i te tā hirau ina neke tere

Ki te kua whakahohe, ka piri te pūtoro ārai i te tā hirau ki te kamera
ina reretere/nekeneke te kaitākaro.

Ka āwhina tēnei ki te whakaiti i ngā raruraru o te kore e taea e Minecraft te
uta/whakatipu poraka i tētahi tere tere rawa mō te DH.
Whakahohe i te kotinga ana

Ki te kua whakahohe, ka kotia ngā ana.

Mōhiohio anō: i tēnei wā ka kotia te katoa o ngā mata e whai ana i te whakamārama-rangi 0
i raro i te teitei kotinga-ana i ngā ārai kāore he tuanui.
Teitei kotinga ana
Me tīmata te kotinga ana i te uara Y hē?
Whakahohe i te kotinga tohu-tawhiti

Ki te kua whakahohe, kāore e tāia ngā tohu e pātata ana ki te kamera hei ārai i te tā hirau vanilla.
Ki te kua kāti, ka tāia ngā tohu katoa.
Kāti i te kotinga ārai

Ki te kua kāti, kāore e tāia ngā LOD kei waho o te ārai o te kaitākaro,
ka pai ake te mahi GPU.

Ki te kua whakahohe, ka tāia ngā LOD katoa, pērā anō ngā mea kei muri o te kamera,
ka kino ake te mahi GPU.

Mēnā ka kite koe i ngā LOD e ngaro ana i te konga o tōu kanohi, kāti tēnei.
Kāti i te kotinga ārai tā-ata

Pēnei i te tawhā kotinga ārai kē, engari ka whakamahia anake
inā noho mai tētahi mod shader e whakamahi ana i te API DH,
ki te wā e tāia ana te āta.

Kāti mehemea e hē ana te tā o ngā atārangi.
CSV o ngā poraka kua wareware

He rārangi kaporowhā-mahue o ngā rohi rauemi poraka
kāore e tāia e DH.
Ka whakaurua tonu te rangi ki tēnei rārangi.

Ka whakatūpato:
Mēnā ka kite koe i ngā rua, i ngā kōhao rānei,
me whakatipu anō ngā LOD ki te [MERGE_SAME_BLOCKS].
CSV o ngā poraka ana kua wareware

He rārangi kaporowhā-mahue o ngā rohi rauemi poraka
kāore e tāia ina noho i te horahanga i raro i te whenua me te whakamārama-rangi 0.
Ka whakaurua tonu te rangi ki tēnei rārangi.

Ko te nuinga o ngā poraka ana ka wareware aunoa nā te mea mārama, kāore i te pakeke, he wai rānei,
nō reira kei te wātea te rārangi mā te taunoa, engari ka taea te tāpiri i ngā poraka hōu i konei ina hiahiatia.
Te whakakapi mata-i-roto o te wai

He rārangi kaporowhā-mahue o ngā rohi rauemi poraka
e whakakapi ana i te wai ina hū ana ki te mata o te wai.
Te whakakapi mata-wai
He rārangi kaporowhā-mahue o ngā rohi rauemi poraka e tangohia ana ina kīhai atu i tā te wai mata.
Ngā poraka kua wareware

Defines what blocks should be rendered as LODs. 

§6NONE:§r Include all blocks in the LODs
§6NON_COLLIDING:§r Only render solid blocks in the LODs (tall grass, torches, etc. will be ignored)
Te tāe i ngā poraka kua wareware

§4Ka whakatūpato: ka tino kino te āhua o te hukarere, o ngā whāriki, o ngā uhi§r
Me tango ngā poraka i raro i ngā poraka kua wareware i tō rāua tae?
§6Whakahohe.§r ka waiho te pātītī ki runga i te pātītī kia whero te tae i te pātītī o raro
§6Kāti.§r kāore e whakarerekē te tae o te mata i raro i ngā poraka kua wareware
Te tuhituhi i ngā tautuhinga vanilla

Ki te kua whakahohe, ka huri aunoa a DH i ētahi tautuhinga whakairoiro vanilla
i te wā o te whakatūtanga mō te wheako pai rawa.

Ko tēnei te kāti i ngā kapua vanilla (e tāia ana ki runga ake o ngā LOD)
me te kāti i te kotinga poraka (kua kotia tonutia e DH ngā poraka MC).
Waihanga whakamātau
Ōwehenga kōnēnētanga o te ao

Ko te uara 1 te hāngai o te kōnēnētanga o te Ao te tuturu.
Ko te mōrahi-iti e whakaaetia ana ko te 50, ko te mōrahi-nui ko te 5000.
Ko ngā mea katoa i waenganui i te 1 me te 49 ka whakaawhiwhia ki te 50.
CSV o ngā ārai kua wareware

He rārangi kaporowhā-mahue o ngā rohi rauemi ārai

Whakahohe i te whakatipu-tawhiti

§6Whakahohe.§r ka whakatipua ngā LOD i waho o te tawhiti tā vanilla i te aratau kaitākaro-tahi.
I runga i te tikanga whakatipu, ka matarua te hirahira o ngā poraka o nāianei, ka/ā rānei
whakatipuhia ngā poraka kāore i te tino.
Ka whakatūpato: ka nui pea te whakamahi CPU.

§6Kāti.§r ka whakatipua ngā LOD i roto anake i te tawhiti tā vanilla.
Mahere whakatipu-tawhiti

Ka whakatau i te whakatipunga o ngā LOD i waho o te tawhiti tā vanilla
i te aratau kaitākaro-tahi.

Tērā pea kāore e wātea ana ētahi tawhā i runga i te putanga MC.

§6SURFACE_THEN_CHUNKS§r
tūtohua mō ngā ao mod, ao vanilla rānei.

§6SURFACE_ONLY§r
tūtohua mō ngā rorohiko kāore e nui ana te kaha CPU
me te rahi RAM hei whakahaere i te whakatipu poraka.

§6CHUNKS_ONLY§r
tūtohua mō ngā ao whirihoroa
e mahi hē ai te whakatipu-mata i te āhua whenua.

§6DISABLED§r
tūtohua mehemea ka kite koe i te whakatōtō.
Tikanga whakatipu poraka
Kia pēhea te matatini o te whakatipu ina whakatipu LOD i waho o te tawhiti tā vanilla.
Whakahohe i te whakatipu-mata tere

Me whakatipu anō te ao mō ngā huringa.

Ki te kua whakahohe, ka whakatipuria e Distant Horizons he whakatau-mata o te āhua whenua
ki te tino tere hei whakakī i te awhe tā.

I muri i te whakatipunga o te mata, ka whakatipuria e Distant Horizons ngā poraka
takitahi ki te tika i ngā rākau me ngā hanganga, pērā ki tā tō mātou "distantGeneratorMode"
tautuhinga e whakatau ai.

Mehemea he ao whirihoroa katoa tōu,
tūtohua kia kāti tēnei tawhā kia kāore
e hua mai te āhua whenua nōmela.
Whakaatu i te āhua whakatipu
Ka whakatau i te whakaaturanga o te āhua whakatipu tawhiti.
Tawhāti whakaatu-aahua, hēkona
Ka whakatau i te wā i waenga i ngā whakaaturanga whakahoutanga-aahua.
Ngā hēkona whakaatu tohutohu-kāti-aahua

Kia pēhea te roa o te whakaaturanga o ngā tohutohu kāti-aahua o te whakatipu-tawhiti?
Ka huna te 0 i ngā karere-tohutohu, ka whakaaturia te āhua whakatipu ao mai i te tīmatanga.
Whakaatu i te tere whakatipu poraka/hēkona

Ina pereka ana i te āhua whakatipu, tāpiri hoki i te tere o te
whakatipunga o ngā poraka.
Ka whai hua tēnei ki te patuiro i ngā raruraru mahi.
Whakatipu hūmārie ina pukumahi te tūmau

Ina pau rawa te wā o te aho tūmau Minecraft,
ka aukati a Distant Horizons i te whakatipu ao hei whakaiti i te maunu/lag o te tūmau.
Whakatipu hūmārie ina neke tere

Ina neke tere te kaitākaro/kamera,
ka aukati a Distant Horizons i te whakatipu ao hei whakapai ake i te tere uta
me te whakaiti i te lag.
Te ōrau mōrahi o te tawhiti whakatipu-mata-anō

Ko te ōrau o te tawhiti tā LOD katoa, e whakakī ana te hīkoi tuarua o te
whakatipu-mata-tere ki ōu poraka kua whakatipuhia, e ai ki tā tō "distantGeneratorMode".
